finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful advantage over base, pooled, donor and uniform rivals is excluded under both interval methods, with all primary intervals including zero. Residual donor useful advantage remains unresolved only under crossed resampling; residual pooled advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, and all residual intervals include zero. Raw base, pooled and donor useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods; all raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch or seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
